# magento.works

> Which Magento Open Source and Mage-OS releases install and run on which PHP, database, search engine, cache, queue, web server and Varnish versions. Every result comes from a real install in Docker. All data is static JSON: no key, no rate limit.

Not affiliated with Adobe or the Mage-OS Association.

## Pages

- [Will it run?](https://magento.works/check/): pick a release and a service version, get a yes or no
- [Magento releases](https://magento.works/magento/): every tested Magento release and upgrade route
- [Mage-OS releases](https://magento.works/mageos/): every tested Mage-OS release and upgrade route
- [Services](https://magento.works/software/): how each PHP, database, search, cache and queue version fares across releases
- [Magento supported versions](https://magento.works/magento/supported-versions/): release dates and Adobe's standard, extended and security-only support dates for every Magento 2.4 line
- [Mage-OS versions](https://magento.works/mageos/supported-versions/): release date of every Mage-OS version
- [Does Magento 2.4.8 run on PHP 8.4?](https://magento.works/magento/2.4.8/php-8.4/): one release line against one service version, with a yes or no up front. Pattern: `/{magento|mageos}/{line}/{type}-{version}/`

## API

- [API reference](https://magento.works/api/): all endpoints with examples
- [Release results](https://magento.works/api/v1/magento/2.4.8-p5.json): every result for one release, with per-step details. Pattern: `/api/v1/{magento|mageos}/{version}.json`
- [Tested releases](https://magento.works/api/v1/magento/versions.json): pattern `/api/v1/{magento|mageos}/versions.json`
- [Service version](https://magento.works/api/v1/software/php/php-8.4.json): how one service version fares across every release. Pattern: `/api/v1/software/{service}/{type}-{version}.json`
- [GitHub Actions matrix](https://magento.works/api/v1/magento/github-matrix.json): stacks that passed, ready for `strategy.matrix`. Per release: `/api/v1/{product}/{version}/github-matrix.json`
- [Matrix definition](https://magento.works/api/v1/matrix.json): every product, release and service version under test
- [Build health](https://magento.works/api/v1/health.json): total results, last run time and pass or fail counts

## Optional

- [All results](https://magento.works/api/v1/results.json): every result in one large file
- [Source and harness](https://github.com/samjuk/magento-compatability): matrix.yml, the Docker harness and every result file
